problem_type: Trace navigation dispatches a package directory through OS file associations
symptom: On macOS, a session .trace directory can launch Instruments instead of showing readable diagnostics.
direct_cause: Both diagnostics entries pass derived directories to shell.openPath.
class_root: Diagnostic navigation must reveal the derived readable file without dispatching its parent extension as an application document.
internal_only_reason: Inspected installed Electron electron.d.ts showItemInFolder(fullPath):void and the native derived trace.md/index.md layout; ownership is application-specific.
invariants: Reveal only an existing native-derived ordinary file for the still-active trusted project.
Success means the OS reveal was requested, not that Finder presentation was acknowledged.

door_reduction.why_not: The single main IPC owner and its registration/type-only renderer consumers stay distinct; both actual navigation callers converge before the shell API.

generality_proof: Both session and project navigation converge on the same IPC resolver, existence check, sender revalidation, and reveal-only shell operation.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Resolve and reveal current derived readable diagnostics without application dispatch.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses shared useAgentTraceDirectory IPC with a validated lane.
Shared IPC without lane resolves native project index.md.

recurrence.reason: Every future session has the same .trace extension; OS file associations vary.
same_class_scan: Inspected session and settings useAgentTraceDirectory calls plus openLaneTraceDirectory return paths.

prevention.invariant: Trace navigation never executes an extension association and never reports a missing file as revealed.
prevention.strategy: Resolve the native readable filename, require a regular file, revalidate identity, then call showItemInFolder.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace shell.openPath with reveal-only navigation in place.

dependency_lifecycle.target: Retain current Electron with documented showItemInFolder.
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Electron already exposes the required reveal semantic; an upgrade does not repair incorrect application dispatch.
exit_criteria: Rerun packaged trace walk before any Electron upgrade.

migration: No stored data changes. Existing derived session trace.md and project index.md are reused.
residual_risks: showItemInFolder has no OS success acknowledgement.
Integrated packaged Finder walk remains coordinator acceptance.
